name: duopore-public-application-deadline-timeline
description: Work backwards from job application deadlines to see when preparation needs to start.

interface.longDescription: Work backwards from job application deadlines to see when preparation needs to start. Enter deadlines, the work needed and your available hours per day. See suggested start dates and flag dates already past. Each application has its own timeline, so check shared work time yourself. For adults planning their own applications. It does not submit applications or send reminders.
defaultPrompt: When should I start preparing for these job deadlines?
Flag application deadlines and preparation dates that have passed.
